events.name: New Orleans Saints at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Jamarca Sanford's interception at the Atlanta 25 with less than two minutes remaining set up Kai Forbath's 30-yard field goal as time expired, giving the New Orleans Saints a 20-17 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forbath's FG on final play sends Saints past Falcons 20-17

events.name: New York Jets at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick threw interceptions on each of New York's final three drives and the Jets' playoff hopes were dashed with a 22-17 loss to the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets blow playoff chance with 22-17 loss to Bills

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw for 298 yards and three touchdowns, Calvin Johnson had 137 yards receiving, and the Lions beat the Chicago Bears 24-20 in what could be coach Jim Caldwell's final game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford, Johnson lead Lions over Bears 24-20

headlines.description: AJ McCarron overcame a rough start and threw a pair of touchdown passes Sunday, rallying the Cincinnati Bengals to a 24-16 victory over the Baltimore Ravens that kept them in the running for a pl
headlines.shortLinkText: McCarron leads playoff-bound Bengals over Ravens 24-16

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw three touchdown passes, Pittsburgh's defense dominated and the Steelers slipped into the AFC playoffs with a 28-12 win over the Cleveland Browns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers beat Browns 28-12, slide into AFC playoffs

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw for three touchdowns before leaving late in the first half of a playoff tuneup, and the Redskins finished the regular season with a 34-23 victory over the Cowboys.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins, Redskins top Cowboys 34-23 in playoff tuneup

headlines.description: Recently signed Josh Freeman and Ryan Lindley each threw one touchdown pass in the first half Sunday, and Jerrell Freeman scored on a 23-yard interception in the second half to lead Indianapolis
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts use backup plan to salvage 30-24 victory over Titans

events.name: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Tom Brady was sacked twice and knocked down at least half a dozen times Sunday, and the New England Patriots missed a chance to clinch the No. 1 seed in the AFC playoffs when they lost to Miami.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats miss chance to clinch No. 1 seed, losing to Miami 20-10

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Giants

headlines.description: The New York Giants suffered another tough loss in what may have been Tom Coughlin's final game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles spoil Coughlin's possible last game with Giants

headlines.description: J.J. Watt and Whitney Mercilus led the defense and Jonathan Grimes scored twice Sunday to help the Houston Texans clinch the AFC South title with a 30-6 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans clinch division title with 30-6 win over Jags

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Peyton Manning replaced Brock Osweiler in the third quarter Sunday and led the Broncos a 27-20 win over the San Diego Chargers that clinched the top seed in the AFC playoffs for Denver.

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Alex Smith threw two TD passes, K.C. sacked Raiders QB Derek Carr six times and the Chiefs held on for a 23-17 victory Sunday to give them a franchise-best 10 straight wins entering the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs beat Raiders 23-17 to enter playoffs on streak

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw three touchdown passes in a second-quarter outburst and the Seattle Seahawks emphatically snapped Arizona's nine-game winning streak with a 36-6 rout of the Cardinals on Sund

events.name: St. Louis Rams at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Phil Dawson kicked his fourth field goal of the game 11:33 into overtime, and the San Francisco 49ers held off the St. Louis Rams 19-16 on Sunday in Jim Tomsula's final game as head coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dawson kicks 23-yard winning field goal, 49ers beat Rams

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton ran for two touchdowns and threw for two more, and the Carolina Panthers captured the NFC's No. 1 seed for the first time in their history with a 38-10 win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneer
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Panthers beat Bucs 38-10, clinch NFC's No. 1 seed

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: The Minnesota Vikings won the NFC North by holding on for a 20-13 win Sunday night over the Green Bay Packers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings take NFC North, hold on to beat Packers 20-13
